headline: Bajaj Resources Discloses Substantial Acquisition in Bajaj Consumer Care under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Bajaj Resources Private Limited filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE regarding a substantial acquisition of shares in listed Bajaj Consumer Care Limited. The filing triggers mandatory takeover regime reporting under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
detail: Bajaj Resources Private Limited submitted a formal disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011. This regulation requires disclosure once a person acquires shares such that their shareholding reaches or exceeds 25% of a target company's issued capital, or acquires further shares equivalent to 2% or more of issued capital in any financial year. The filing confirms the transaction proceeded through stock exchange-regulated channels and was subject to mandatory disclosure and takeover code compliance.
